answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the opal graph and each risks its bond. Because the ripple release is entered with every signature, the velvet audit exposes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 8 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Each copy needs 7 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
